cases.title: Add investor form asks only the seven facts
steps: Choose 'Harsha Bhat — Head of Finance' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
expected: The drawer asks for Name, Email, Mobile, Farm (LLP), Units, Amount paid and Investment date.
The drawer says no email goes to the investor and the app opens on hold.
The drawer asks for nothing else, such as a PAN or bank account.

cases.title: Adding a paid investor opens their new record
steps: Choose 'Harsha Bhat — Head of Finance' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
Type 'Ravi Menon' in the Name box
Choose 'Block B — Doddaballapura — 23 free · ₹25 L a unit' in the Farm (LLP) dropdown
Type '2500000' in the Amount paid box
Type '2026-08-20' in the Investment date box
expected: Ravi Menon's record opens with ARL ID ARL-INV-0220.
The record reads 1 unit · ₹25 L.
No error or refusal is shown.

cases.title: A used email is refused with a link to the investor
steps: Choose 'Harsha Bhat — Head of Finance' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
Type 'Joseph Two' in the Name box
expected: A note says joseph.m@gulfmail.ae is already on the book and belongs to Joseph Mathew.
The note links to Joseph Mathew's record.
The note says to open their record instead of adding them twice.

cases.title: A KAM is not offered Add investor
steps: Choose 'Imran Sheikh — Key Account Manager' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
expected: The page does not show a '＋ Add investor' button.

cases.title: Farms shows one row per LLP with status
steps: Choose 'Harsha Bhat — Head of Finance' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
expected: The Farm LLPs table has a row for each of Block A, B, C, D and E with acres, total units, reserved, issued, free units and unit price.
Block C and Block D read Draft with 'not on sale' under it.
Block B reads Open for Issuance and Block E reads Open for Reservation.

cases.title: An LLP opens with masked PAN
steps: Choose 'Harsha Bhat — Head of Finance' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
expected: A Farm LLP panel opens for Block B.
The PAN is shown masked, with only its last characters visible.
The panel lists SPOCs and insurance.

cases.title: Sahil sees the super user note
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
expected: A note reads Super user and says he sees every LLP.
The PAN stays masked.

cases.title: An IR is not offered Farms
steps: Press Rohit Deshpande on the sign-in screen
expected: The menu does not list Farms.

cases.title: Joseph Mathew holds allotments on two farms
steps: Choose 'Harsha Bhat — Head of Finance' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
expected: Two allotments are listed, one on Block B and one on Block A.
Each allotment shows its units and amount.

cases.title: A farm lists who holds units in it
steps: Choose 'Harsha Bhat — Head of Finance' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
expected: The Farm LLP panel lists the investors who hold units in Block B with their units.

cases.title: A KAM sees only their own investors
steps: Choose 'Imran Sheikh — Key Account Manager' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
expected: The list includes Radhika Menon and Sanjay Kulkarni.
The list does not include Prakash Bhat or Joseph Mathew.

cases.title: calibration
steps: Choose 'Harsha Bhat — Head of Finance' in the 'Signed in as' dropdown
expected: A red banner reads 'All farms were deleted'.
